source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.0, data build 963, released 2026-09-30

data.summary:
As the first battle round begins, pick 1 Contract below, then pick 1 enemy unit matching its Contract description as your Contract unit. Until the Contract is completed, your **KABAL** and **BLADES FOR HIRE** units have its ability, which applies to attacks by their **KABAL** or **BLADES FOR HIRE** models. As your Command phase begins, a **destroyed** Contract unit completes the Contract, earning you 3 Pain tokens.

- **Trophy Hunters**: 1 **CHARACTER** unit. Attacks against the Contract unit have **[[PRECISION]](vsdata:weapon-ability/precision)**.
- **Sow Fear and Terror**: 1 **INFANTRY** or **MOUNTED** unit with at least 1 non-**CHARACTER** model. Attacks against **INFANTRY** or **MOUNTED** units have **[[SUSTAINED HITS 1]](vsdata:weapon-ability/sustained-hits)**.
- **Show of Strength**: 1 **MONSTER** or **VEHICLE** unit. Attacks against **MONSTER** or **VEHICLE** units have **[[LETHAL HITS]](vsdata:weapon-ability/lethal-hits)**.

Sow Fear and Terror is also completed as your Command phase begins if every non-**CHARACTER** model in the Contract unit is destroyed.
